prior_knowledge.concept: Paired counterweight decks respond to riders and cargo weight.

evidence.claim: Earlier cargo exchange uses linked weight-driven decks and movable nutrient sac.

mechanics.fact: A and B are linked counterweight decks. Pac plus the light sac on A outweigh Isp on B, so A travels down while B rises; at the far stop, moving Isp above and the sac to B changes the load relation and reverses the travel.

evidence.claim: Source hint describes load balance, far-stop crossing, sac transfer, and swapping decks; counterweights define paired travel.

mechanics.fact: The commissure and upper signal fold are fixed crossing surfaces. Two slime shafts at the bottoms of the deck wells harm both heroes; a recovery shelf/floor catches a dropped sac on the left.

evidence.claim: Source defines crossing geometry, sac recovery surface, and damaging shaft floors.

steps.action: Push the light sac onto A; Pac rides with it and Isp rides B.
